verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch has first-class environments that hold variable sets, including secret variables (docs-7). Environments can be imported alongside collections (docs-33), and the MCP server exposes them as a top-level object (docs-32), so swapping variable sets per target environment is clearly supported. The evidence is mostly brief changelog lines, though, so the per-request switching workflow itself is only implied. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of selecting or switching the active environment for a request, examples of dev/staging/prod variable substitution in URLs and headers, and independent hands-on corroboration.
